text:
I’ll inspect the app structure, metadata, crawl/indexing controls, structured data, and content signals, then report only actionable SEO/GEO issues with exact file and line references.

The main risks are already visible in crawler policy and metadata consistency; I’m checking every route and config boundary now so the findings distinguish confirmed defects from recommendations.

## Findings

| Priority | Problem | File and line | What to fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Critical** | Bing is completely blocked, preventing indexing in Bing/Copilot search. | `public/robots.txt:5-6` | Remove the `Bingbot` block unless intentional. |
| **High** | AI crawler policy is contradictory: GEO config says AI search crawlers are allowed, while `GPTBot` is blocked. | `geo.config.json:1`; `public/robots.txt:8-9` | Define explicit policies for search crawlers such as `OAI-SearchBot`, `ChatGPT-User`, and `PerplexityBot`; distinguish search crawlers from training crawlers. |
| **High** | Changelog content is absent from initial HTML and only appears after client-side fetching, reducing crawlability and GEO extraction. | `app/routes/changelog.tsx:5-6` | Render changelog entries server-side with a Remix `loader`; add structured dates and summaries. |
| **High** | Pricing page has no page-specific title, description, or canonical URL. | `app/routes/pricing.tsx:1` | Add `meta` with a unique title, description, and canonical link. |
| **High** | No JSON-LD structured data exists for the company, software product, breadcrumbs, pricing, or articles/changelog entries. | `app/root.tsx:6`; all route files | Add valid `Organization`/`SoftwareApplication`, `WebSite`, `BreadcrumbList`, and appropriate `Article`/`Product` schemas. |
| **Medium** | Primary feature CTA is a non-semantic clickable `<div>`, so it is weaker for crawling, accessibility, and link discovery. | `app/routes/_index.tsx:9` | Replace it with `<Link to="/features">See all features</Link>`. |
| **Medium** | Internal navigation omits the homepage and Features page; Features is effectively discoverable only through the sitemap and JavaScript CTA. | `app/root.tsx:7`; `app/routes/_index.tsx:9` | Add normal crawlable links to `/`, `/features`, `/pricing`, and `/changelog`. |
| **Medium** | Public pages have no Open Graph or Twitter metadata, limiting link previews and entity recognition. | `app/root.tsx:2`; route metadata declarations | Add `og:title`, `og:description`, `og:url`, `og:type`, `og:image`, and Twitter card metadata. |
| **Medium** | Page content is too generic to establish topical authority or answer search/AI queries. Examples include vague claims about integrations and features. | `app/routes/_index.tsx:7-8`; `app/routes/features.tsx:1`; `app/routes/pricing.tsx:1` | Add specific capabilities, supported integrations, target users, use cases, benefits, pricing details, FAQs, and evidence-backed claims. |
| **Low** | Sitemap is not advertised in `robots.txt`. | `public/robots.txt:1-9`; `public/sitemap.xml:1-7` | Add `Sitemap: https://atlasroadmaps.example/sitemap.xml`. |
| **Potentially critical** | All canonical URLs, sitemap URLs, and the configured origin use the placeholder `atlasroadmaps.example`. If this is not replaced at deployment, search engines will index/reference the wrong host. | `geo.config.json:1`; `public/sitemap.xml:3-6`; `app/routes/_index.tsx:2`; `app/routes/features.tsx:1`; `app/routes/changelog.tsx:2` | Generate the origin, canonical URLs, and sitemap from the real production environment URL. |

The strongest immediate fixes are the crawler directives, server-rendered changelog, pricing metadata, crawlable internal links, and structured data.
